scope: Validate source-order resolution of proxy ATTRIBUTE_LAYER/ATTRIBUTE_LINETYPE indices and report unresolved table references without failing the enclosing DWG read.

behavior.omittedLookupTable: Keep the parent layer/linetype inherited, as the decoder API contract specifies.
behavior.suppliedLookupTable: Resolve the proxy index against the supplied source-storage-order vector.
behavior.missingOrOutOfRangeLayer: Increment unresolvedResourceReferenceCount, retain the prior decoded layer or parent layer, and continue decoding.
behavior.missingOrOutOfRangeLinetype: Increment unresolvedResourceReferenceCount, retain the existing BYLAYER rendering fallback, and continue decoding.
behavior.diagnostic: The DWG reader traces the per-stream unresolved reference count without failing the record.
behavior.sentinels: Existing BYBLOCK/BYLAYER sentinel decoding is unchanged.

profiles: ATTRIBUTE_LAYER index 1 maps to SOURCE_LAYER_1 even when the parent layer has a different name.
ATTRIBUTE_LINETYPE index 1 maps to SOURCE_LTYPE_1 even when the parent linetype has a different name.
An omitted linetype lookup table leaves the parent linetype inherited.
A supplied linetype vector missing index 1 reports one unresolved reference and continues with BYLAYER fallback.
A supplied layer vector with an empty entry at index 1 reports one unresolved reference and continues with the parent layer.
generatedControl.fixturePolicy: Proxy bytes are generated in memory. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.
